claims.text: OpenAI’s current API pricing page lists gpt-rosalind-research at $5 per 1M input tokens, $0.50 per 1M cached input tokens and $25 per 1M output tokens, and says cache-write pricing does not apply.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: OpenAI states that billing for gpt-rosalind-research begins on October 5, 2026; this activation observed the listed date but did not inspect an invoice or transaction proving a customer was charged.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: OpenAI limits GPT-Rosalind API access to approved internal research through its trusted-access program and says it is not available for customer-facing or external commercial applications at this time.

evidence_gaps.description: No independently attributable usage record confirms that an eligible customer was billed on the scheduled effective date.
No matched cost per validated scientific workflow is available; token rates omit token mix, tool costs, retries and human supervision.

importance_rationale: If the posted schedule applies as stated, it sets a concrete marginal API cost for qualified internal life-sciences research deployments and makes cost-per-validated-workflow comparison possible; this meaningfully affects deployment economics without demonstrating capability or productivity.
limitations: The billing start date is an OpenAI-published schedule; no invoice, transaction log or independent eligible-customer account was available to confirm that a charge occurred today.
The listed token rates do not determine cost per task: input/output token mix, cache hit rate, tool charges, retries and human review are unmeasured.
Access remains restricted to approved internal research; the API is not available for customer-facing or external commercial applications according to OpenAI’s current access documentation.
The price page alone does not establish scientific capability, research productivity, or cost-effectiveness relative to other models.
The sources specify a scheduled billing-start day without an hour or timezone; the exact activation time is unknown.
summary: OpenAI’s API pricing page lists gpt-rosalind-research at $5 per 1 million input tokens, $0.50 per 1 million cached input tokens and $25 per 1 million output tokens; the page states billing begins October 5, 2026. The API changelog dates the trusted-access release and these standard rates to September 8. This makes a model-specific marginal API price visible for approved internal life-sciences research, but the sources reviewed establish the posted schedule rather than an observed customer charge or a cost per validated scientific result.

title: OpenAI lists GPT-Rosalind research API rates and schedules billing from October 5
why_it_matters: A posted model-specific rate is a concrete input to whether qualified research teams can operationalize specialized scientific-model workflows. The listed output rate is five times the uncached input rate and fifty times the cached-input rate, so actual workflow economics depend on token mix, caching, tools and supervision. No benchmark-to-cost or scientific productivity conclusion follows from the rate alone.
